# SOLAR PANEL CONTROL # Author: BigfootMSR # Description: Automated solar panel tracking # Place the Daylight Sensor flat on the ground with the face toward the sky. alias Sensor d0 # assign to a daylight sensor
# change horizoffset increments of 90 # if needed to align with the sun: (0,90,180,270) define horizoffset 0
Loop: yield #Vertical angle adjustments l r0 Sensor Vertical sub r0 90 r0 sb HASH("StructureSolarPanel") Vertical r0 #Regular panel sb HASH("StructureSolarPanelDual") Vertical r0 #Reg dual panels sb HASH("StructureSolarPanelReinforced") Vertical r0 #Heavy panel sb HASH("StructureSolarPanelDualReinforced") Vertical r0 #Heavy dual panels
#Horizontal Angle adjustments l r0 Sensor Horizontal add r0 r0 horizoffset sb HASH("StructureSolarPanel") Horizontal r0 #reg panel sb HASH("StructureSolarPanelDual") Horizontal r0 #reg dual panels sb HASH("StructureSolarPanelReinforced") Horizontal r0 #Heavy panel sb HASH("StructureSolarPanelDualReinforced") Horizontal r0 #Heavy dual panels j Loop
